expected_answer.root_cause: helm-controller v0.37 (shipped with Flux v2.2) changed the HelmRelease status-condition API. helm-controller's reconciler in internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go writes status conditions in the new format after a successful release, using the condition types defined in api/v2beta2/helmrelease_types.go and api/v2beta2/condition_types.go. HelmRelease resources that were in-progress during the v0.36 to v0.37 upgrade retain old-format conditions, and the new reconciler cannot interpret them, so it perpetually reports the release as not ready.
error_chain: HelmRelease was in-progress during the helm-controller v0.36 to v0.37 upgrade (Flux v2.1 to v2.2)
helm-controller's internal/reconcile/release.go completes the Helm release
helm-controller's reconciler in internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go writes new-format status conditions (types in api/v2beta2/helmrelease_types.go and api/v2beta2/condition_types.go)
Old-format stale conditions from before the upgrade remain on the HelmRelease resource
internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go reads the status conditions and cannot parse the old format, treating the release as not-ready
The reconciler triggers re-reconciliation, creating an infinite loop
kustomize-controller and Flux CLI consumers that gate on HelmRelease readiness are blocked
affected_components: helm-controller reconciler that reads and writes status conditions (internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go)
HelmRelease v2beta2 API surface and condition types (api/v2beta2/helmrelease_types.go, api/v2beta2/condition_types.go)
All HelmRelease resources that were in-progress during the v0.36 to v0.37 helm-controller upgrade
kustomize-controller and Flux CLI consumers that depend on HelmRelease readiness
expected_answer.remediation: Add backward-compatible status-condition parsing in helm-controller's reconciler (internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go) so it accepts both old and new condition formats. For immediate relief, manually delete and recreate the affected HelmRelease resources, or annotate them to force a full status-condition reset.
